summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: @servicetitan/anvil-react@0.11.5 ships a preinstall hook (`package.json` `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`) that fetches the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/...` at install time and invokes it via `execFileSync` against `math_init.js`, a 727,680-byte heavily obfuscated file at the tarball root. `math_init.js` uses hex-identifier obfuscation, a shuffled string/number array (`n7gIxM`), and a rotation decoder (`WV8StW`), and is not listed in `package.json` `files` (which only declares `dist`). `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifiers and string-lookup objects (`_0x488df8`, `_0x19328d.YCZJE(...)`) wrapping the `execFileSync` and GitHub-release-URL construction. A React component library has no legitimate reason to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time to execute an undeclared, obfuscated blob; using Bun rather than Node bypasses Node-based install-time inspection and consumer sandboxes. The obfuscated payload runs with the installer's privileges on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
